issues.description: The problem statement's UML and text specify getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() should return a double (to allow fractional students per tutor), but the solution implementation declares and returns an int. This mismatch can cause confusion and failing tests if students implement or are tested against the UML specification expecting a double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the UML: change the solution method signature to public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() and compute using floating-point division, e.g. return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); or alternatively update the problem statement/UML to indicate an int return if integer division is intended.
